out_of_domain.sqm_max_note: Largest raw sqm value in the scraped data. The Results section cites this as the input-domain noise example.

data_quality.note: Recorded, not cleaned. Bounds the Batch 4 application's inputs and is a stated limitation in the Results & Discussion.
data_quality.missing_pct_note: Share of rows with no value per model input, measured on the 226,438 deduplicated listings. Backs the missing-values figure and the input-domain discussion in the Results & Discussion; these are recorded, not imputed.

application.note: Streamlit publishes no cp314 wheel: its pyarrow pin is <22, and the earliest pyarrow with a cp314 wheel is 23. The model environment here is Python 3.14.6, so streamlit cannot be installed and the UI could not be launched on this interpreter. app/predict.py therefore holds no streamlit import, so the prediction logic is fully testable on 3.14 via tests/test_app.py. To run the UI, use Python 3.13 or earlier.
application.replicated_training_step: The condo lot_area_m2 back-fill was a dataframe step in the training notebook, not part of the saved pipeline, so predict.py repeats it. Omitting it changes a real condo prediction by about 6%.
application.artifact_size_note: 206.0 MiB (216.0 MB). Older notes in CONTEXT.md and RESULTS_LOG.md say '206MB', which is the MiB figure; both are correct.

parity_check.note: One real condo row replayed through the notebook's own preprocessing.
parity_check.row_selected_by: first condo row with a missing lot_area_m2 and a known sqm

numeric_input_bounds.note: Ceilings the app enforces, imported from app/predict.py NUMERIC_BOUNDS. Deliberately far below the raw-data extremes.
